Definition: from G5485; to grace, i.e. indue with special honor:--make accepted, be highly favoured.
BiblicalUsage: Charitoo is to grace, to make accepted, to highly favour, and it appears twice, both times of grace given. God hath made us accepted in the beloved, to the praise of the glory of His grace. And the angel said to Mary, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses are one doctrine: the favour Mary received is the same favour every believer receives in the Beloved.
